references.text: The same chapter mentions that the Levites' gift shall be reckoned as grain from the threshing floor and as produce from the winepress.
Refers to gifts from the threshing floor and the winepress that are to be given to the Levites.
Describes the firstfruits of grain and new wine that are to be given to the priests and the Levites.
Explains that the tithe from Israel is given to the Levites as their inheritance.
Refers to the tithe of the land, both of the crops of the field and of the fruit of the trees, which belongs to the Lord.
The Levites shall give a tenth of the tithes they receive as an offering to the Lord.
